description:
The Senior Technical Sales Executive is responsible for developing and growing SGS Hardlines technical testing services across furniture, toys, juvenile products, household goods, cookware and food-contact items, sporting goods, tools and general merchandise. The role combines technical expertise with sales and business development to provide practical testing and compliance solutions to clients.
Key Responsibilities
* Develop and execute sales plans to grow Hardlines testing services and achieve assigned revenue targets across Central Vietnam.
* Conduct onsite visits to manufacturers and suppliers, providing technical guidance on product standards, testing methods, regulatory requirements and compliance risks.
* Build and maintain relationships with manufacturers, exporters, suppliers, retailers, buying offices and sourcing companies to develop new and repeat business.
* Understand client requirements and translate technical needs into suitable testing solutions, proposals, pricing and commercial offers.
* Develop market penetration activities, analyze market and competitor information, and prepare sales forecasts and recommendations.
* Collaborate with Technical, Customer Service, Operations and Project Management teams to ensure effective project delivery and resolve client issues.
* Represent SGS at seminars, webinars, exhibitions and industry events to promote services and expand the client base.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Product Design, Materials Science, Quality Management or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience in testing service sales, QA/QC solutions or technical product sales , preferably within Hardlines or the broader consumer goods industry.
* Strong technical understanding of Hardlines products, testing standards and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent sales, communication, negotiation and presentation skills, with strong client relationship management capabilities.
* Good command of English , both spoken and written, and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Willing to travel domestically and internationally as required.
